content.thinking:
I'm checking whether the 23:21 deployment is internally consistent—account_page.py now reads found.amount_cents to match summary_cache.py's new SummaryEntry format parsed from "amount_cents/items_counted", so I need to verify the write side matches this new schema too.

But the error "'2400/8' is not a figure in cents" suggests something else is happening: this string looks like valid new-format data, yet it's failing as if old code tried to parse it as a bare integer. That points to a version mismatch across replicas—some instances running the new revision write entries in "2400/8" format, while others still on the old revision read the cache expecting a plain integer cents value, causing the parse failure.

This matches the in-flight-compatibility-break pattern perfectly: with the rollout split at 3/6 old and 3/6 new revisions and now paused, the shared external cache holds entries in a mixed format, so old-revision replicas parsing entries written by new-revision replicas (or vice versa) fail with that exact error. So the failure_mode is in-flight-compatibility-break, the subject is the revision split, and the from_state transition is one revision to another.

hypotheses.subject: io-shop deployment 696c33a68b36aed6456cdc5b3806f33038488515 vs 5470c1a64205bb28f9f2e8a96dc6ffa5eb2e611e (summary cache entry format)
hypotheses.summary: The 23:21 deployment (696c33a6...) changed the shared summary-cache entry format from a bare cents integer to a composite 'amount_cents/items_counted' string, and the rollout stalled with 3 of 6 replicas on the old revision and 3 on the new one (rollout paused, not converged). Old-revision replicas still parse cache entries as a bare integer, so when they read an entry written by a new-revision replica ('2400/8'), parsing fails with exactly the observed error, and vice versa - a compatibility break that exists only because both versions are live against the same cache at once.

supporting_evidence.claim: Deployment of io-shop has not converged: 3 of 6 replicas are running revision [696c33a68b36aed6456cdc5b3806f33038488515], and 3 are still running revision [5470c1a64205bb28f9f2e8a96dc6ffa5eb2e611e]. Its rolling update is paused
